description.en-US: Richard Hopkins's 1582 English version of the first part of Louis of Granada's Libro de la oración y meditación: the great profit of consideration, the five parts of prayer, the fourteen meditations for the mornings and evenings of the week, the advices for meditation and the six points of the Redemption. The Spanish book's second part (on devotion) is not in this volume, and the division of chapters differs, so it is its own book.
description.pt-BR: A versão inglesa de Richard Hopkins (1582) da primeira parte do Libro de la oración y meditación de Luís de Granada.

sources.edition: Of Prayer and Meditation, wherein are conteined fowertien devoute meditations for the seven daies of the weeke, translated by Richard Hopkins (1582), EEBO-TCP A06436.
sources.description: EEBO-TCP hand-keyed transcription (A06436), old spelling kept; long s printed as s. 65 illegible places in the source are marked […]. Marginal notes are footnotes. Raw TEI in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Printed 1582; the TCP transcription is released to the public domain (CC0).
